text:
incident-bot: Pager: multi-region failover triggered; control-plane reports unhealthy endpoints in eu-west-1 and traffic-shift stuck at 65% -> eu-central-1. Paging oncall: @maria-g (primary)

maria-g: I'm on it. seeing 5xx spike for customer-facing inference proxies in eu-west-1. Load balancer health checks returning 502/504. Beginning triage.

aj: tagging in for networking. any active maintenance in eu-west-1? I don't see scheduled events.

maria-g: none. metrics:
```
500s: +420% in last 5m
P95 latency (eu-west-1): 1.8s -> 3.6s
traffic-shift progress: 65% -> stuck
```

sree: I can take control-plane side. Looks like our routing daemon retried failover but BGP sessions with the region's fabric flapped. netops-bot, do you have infra alerts?

netops-bot: AWS AZ eu-west-1b reported partial network disruption, affecting ENI re-attaches. See cloud provider status: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/xxx

olivia-cs: CS triage: two paying customers reported API timeouts, one logged increased error budget alerts. Flagging customer-impact: medium-high.

aj: quick checks — traceroute from eu-west edge -> internal gw shows long AS path, some packets dropped. running `mtr -c 50` now.

maria-g: we attempted automated failover to eu-central-1 but controllers rolled forward partial sessions. Some upstream caches kept directing 65% traffic to eu-west-1 (sticky ELB connection draining). Need manual intervention to avoid split-brain traffic.

sree: plan: 1) Pause automated traffic-shift 2) Force a full rollback to eu-central-1 3) Clear stale connection trackers / ELB drains in eu-west-1 4) Notify customers and open mitigation window.

aj: I can pause the traffic-shift controller. Command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://control.redwood.example/api/traffic-shifts/active/pause
```

maria-g: paused. traffic-shift state: PAUSED (controller v2). Confirming edge cache purge in progress.

sree: initiating rollback to eu-central-1 and forcing route override for regional routing policy. Applying override now:
```
PATCH /api/routing/policies/primary
{ "force_region": "eu-central-1", "reason": "manual rollback due to stuck shift" }
```

netops-bot: Route update propagated to edge POPs: 72/80 POPs confirmed, 8 pending (mostly in eu-west POP cluster).

aj: for the pending POPs, we're seeing ENI attach retries; will open cloud-side support case and request expedited fabric stability.

olivia-cs: drafting customer notice. Will ping affected accounts: acct-551, acct-992, acct-204. ETA for full rollback?

maria-g: current estimate 18-22 minutes to converge once last POPs accept override. P95 should drop and 5xxs should fall after that.

sree: manual cleanup commands for stuck ELB connections:
```
for elb in $(list-elbs --region eu-west-1 --filter draining); do
  aws elb deregister-instances --load-balancer-name $elb --instances $(list-stuck-instances $elb)
done
```

aj: cloud support acknowledged, we have an open ticket with severity-high. They note fabric instability in eu-west-1b may take longer.

maria-g: notifying oncall handoff at +40m to @sree. If rollback doesn't complete by then, escalation to ENG SRE.

netops-bot: Update: cloud provider reports partial mitigation for network fabric, some ENIs reattached.

maria-g: seeing 5xxs drop to +60% -> +15% over 10m. Traffic now at 95% eu-central-1 per control plane (override applied). Edge pending POPs still finishing.

olivia-cs: sending interim customer message: "We're experiencing a regional outage in eu-west-1 causing elevated errors. We've forced traffic to eu-central-1 and are monitoring convergence. No data loss expected. Next update in 30m." :mailbox_with_mail:

aj: note — during rollback we saw increased tail latency for warm KV cache misses. Suggest enabling short-term cache warmup on eu-central-1 nodes to reduce errors.

sree: warmup started: fanout small synthetic load to prefill caches. Watch for increased request rate cost.

maria-g: >1h from incident start: last_message_ts update. Current status: degraded -> partial-service. 5xxs mostly normalized to baseline for most customers. Affected POPs reduced to 2.

olivia-cs: proactively flagged top 5 customers for account exec outreach. No legal/regulatory SLA breach expected but document impact for postmortem.

maria-g: handing off to @sree for next oncall window. Handoff notes:
- incident id: INC-2025-0543
- root cause: AZ network fabric instability caused ENI attach failures -> partial node pool unavailability -> automated traffic-shift partial progress + sticky ELB drains
- mitigation: paused controller, forced regional override to eu-central-1, cleared ELB drains, warmed caches
- customer impact: 18-55 minute increased error window for some queries, no data loss
- followups: create runbook for force-rollback procedure and fix sticky-drain detection

sree: taking over. I'll open the postmortem stub and schedule follow-ups with netops and infra owners. cc: @maria-g great work.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-0543 acknowledged by sree. Reminder: create incident timeline and attach logs: /incidents/1757654321/logs

maria-g: quick note — add a check in traffic-shift controller to detect ELB drain stalls and auto-fail to full rollback sooner.

sree: noted. I'll own the follow-up ticket. closing slack thread for now; will update with postmortem link.

olivia-cs: thanks team. Will post customer follow-up once we have timeline.

netops-bot: Cloud provider final update: eu-west-1 partial fabric issue resolved. Monitoring continues.

maria-g: incident status: RESOLVED -> monitoring. final: rollback successful, traffic full in eu-central-1 for the affected routes. prepping postmortem.
